feedback: NO CHANGES NEEDED. The candidate provides exactly one predicate per declared proposition (has_matching_key, key_found, target_door_open, target_picked_up, target_room_entered), each named exactly and taking only env, with single-expression single-return bodies, only allowed builtins (max, any, range, comprehensions), no imports/assignments/loops/sibling calls, no mutation, and no .get on the previous valuation. Semantics check out against the grounding: key_found implements the documented latch (previous valuation disjunct, false on first step via the all-false first-step valuation) plus the endorsed view check any(cell[0] == 5 ...) over env.gen_obs()[image], so it can be true at the first step and stays latched after pickup; it reads only the observation, never descriptions or RM state. has_matching_key and target_door_open locate the locked door by place exactly as instructed — the ball's y (guarded with default=env.agent_pos[1] and cell is not None before attribute reads) gives the room row via y // (room_size - 1), the left wall column env.width - env.room_size is scanned over the room's full span, which contains exactly the one door that starts locked — and do not rely on is_locked; has_matching_key compares the carried key's color to that door's color, and target_door_open reads its is_open so it can turn false when toggled shut, matching the condition semantics. target_picked_up reads env.carrying and matches the mission string built from the carried ball's color, avoiding hard-coded colors. target_room_entered implements the latch plus the current-position check x >= width - room_size and the room block y in [row*(room_size-1), row*(room_size-1)+room_size-1], which includes the doorway cell (doorway counts as inside) and covers every reachable cell; unreachable wall cells in the block are harmless. All scans guard missing cells with is not None; no invented API attributes are used; the ordering constraints (key found before key carried, key before door, door before room, room before ball, key and ball never co-carried) hold under these readings and reproduce the example trace.
